mentions.name: Else
mentions.description: A collaborative environment for rapid iteration on the first 20% and last 20% of feature development. Every branch pushed gets a collaborative environment where design, PM, QA, and engineers can comment and make changes live until everyone signs off and the feature ships.
mentions.problem: Agents crank out code fast, but the first 20% of feature development (making sure you're building the right thing) and the last 20% (confirming it made sense and fixing bugs) are the bottlenecks.
mentions.audience: Agents crank out code fast, but the first 20% of feature development (making sure you're building the right thing) and the last 20% (confirming it made sense and fixing bugs) are the bottlenecks.
